choosePrompt: You played a {{card}} -- choose which card to take
landscapeBanner: Rotate your device for a better view of the cards
hint.play: this card captures the most points
hint.select: this is the most valuable card you may take
tutorial.field: The centre is the field. Play a card of the same month from your hand and you take both.
tutorial.match: Click a hand card to play it. With no match it goes to the field, and then one card is turned from the stock.
tutorial.wild: The willow lightning card, marked ★, is wild: it takes any card that is not a willow. Holding it until a bright appears is the standard play.
tutorial.captured: Captures are public for both sides. Watch what your opponent is collecting before you hand over a card.
tutorial.controls: The round settles once the hands are empty. There is no koi-koi style stop decision.
wildRule: The ★ lightning card is wild — it takes any field card EXCEPT a willow
